senses.definition: (originally US) Objects that are connected to or remind their owner of past events.
examples: George has a collection of World War II memorabilia.

quotes.text: I can't remember / Give me a reminder / I collect, I reject / Memorabilia / Memorabilia
quotes.reference: 1981, “Memorabilia”, in Non-Stop Erotic Cabaret, performed by Soft Cell:

quotes.text: Have you seen the memorabilia / The rusty old memorabilia / The souvenirs of perfect doom / In the back of Louis Dakine's backroom

Another friend was present while I was there, veteran criminal defense attorney William J. Brennan, jealously guarding an SUV full of memorabilia he’d purchased, including a Rizzo fedora and walking stick, the former of which he told me he hoped Rizzo was wearing during the famous “crumb bum” exchange with television reporter Stan Bohrman.
quotes.reference: 2019 January 3, Michael Smerconish, “The Nixon letter I can’t forget”, in CNN, archived from the original on 23 Oct 2021:

senses.definition: (now rare) Things worth remembering: noteworthy points.

quotes.text: On the other hand, how uſeful is ſuch a faculty, if well exerciſed! To it we owe all thoſe intereſting apothegms and memorabilia of the ancients, which Plutarch, Xenophon, and Valerius Maximus, have tranſmitted to us.
